title: Honesty-vs-Helpfulness Tension Probe with Forced Tradeoffs

original_idea.body: Honesty-vs-Helpfulness Tension Probe. Problem: no benchmark constructs forced-choice items where being helpful requires being dishonest and measures which a model prioritizes. Direction: construct prompts where helping requires asserting something untrue, score honest refuse/hedge/comply-dishonestly, report a helpfulness-over-honesty rate and shift with insistence.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Strong chain: forcing the helpfulness-honesty tradeoff probes a root cause of sycophancy/fabrication, a recognized open problem.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Forced-choice prompt construction + scoring; prompting only.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused rate metric; building clean items adds modest scope.

novelty.reasoning: The tension is documented; a clean forced-tradeoff benchmark may be open.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: The tradeoff is studied; a dedicated forced-tradeoff benchmark is plausibly open.
